items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a margin-normalised cap rule -- corrected re-test on fresh seeds (R_STAR=2.45, extended sweep, H-KNIFE routing wired)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). Corrected same-question re-queue of V3-EXQ-935 (FAIL, 2026-08-17), confirmed-autopsied as a pure measurement/instrument defect (REE_assembly evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-935_2026-08-18.md/.json, Step 8 gate cleared 2026-08-18), NOT a substrate ceiling. All four driver defects fixed per the autopsy's Section 9 routing: (1) aliasing control (H-KNIFE) now WIRED into the routing using the CORRECTED experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py primitive (classify_regime_shape, ree-v3 606aea2, >=2-adjacent-swept-values on >=2/3-of-seeds bar), called ONCE over all (seed,r) cells, never per-seed (935's own per-seed info-only call was the exact shape that produced 934's false positive); (2) route_reason derived from the actual criterion states at verdict time, never hardcoded per branch (935's was factually false on its own run); (3) R_STAR=2.45 pre-registered from 935's OWN five-seed sweep (935's imported R_STAR=2.25 did not survive the 3-commit substrate move from 934); (4) ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT gated on a literal substrate_hash comparison against 935's recorded hash (921d0af6b6b6c54b12baafb090984edd9fcc2c3f5bf4ed2ba84d36f6c040b99b), stamped into the manifest as substrate_hash_matches_v3_935, rather than 935's prose assertion of substrate identity (which was in fact false -- 935 ran 3 ree_core commits apart from 934). R_SWEEP extended to [2.25,2.45,2.65,2.85,3.05] so the graded window's UPPER edge is measured (935 topped out at 2.65, still grading 4/5 seeds; a seed-42-class agent needs r>2.65, untested by 935). SEEDS=[47,48,49,50,51], ENTIRELY fresh -- neither R_STAR nor the extended sweep were derived from any of these seeds, unlike 935 which mixed derivation seeds (42-44) with partly-fresh seeds (45-46) in one run; the in-run C2-out-of-sample split 935 used is therefore not carried forward (935's C3, beats-best-absolute-cap, is renamed this run's C2 -- two load-bearing criteria, not three; see DESIGN SIMPLIFICATION in the driver's module docstring). Named upstream substrate mode-governance-engagement LANDED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md: external-task-salience-source-for.md 2026-06-13; regime-occupancy-reproducibility.md 2026-09-11) -- brake RELEASED per Step 2.5b item 1. V3-EXQ-935 itself is independent confirmation: its own confirmed autopsy recommends SD-032a weakens->supports because the register 'performed better here than anywhere else in this lineage' (graded, non-degenerate occupancy 0.124-0.925, 15-26 genuine switches/cell on 4/5 seeds). | Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: mode-governance-engagement was the one open corrupting-severity substrate_queue.json entry overlapping this driver's imports (via regime_occupancy_gate.py); governance cycle gov-20260911-1612/GFLAG-0262 reassessed severity corrupting->cosmetic, ready:false->true (no open defect remains for Step 2.5c to protect other experiments from -- confirmed live in substrate_queue.json at authoring time, 2026-09-14). No other open corrupting entry overlaps this driver's imports (ree_core.agent, causal_grid_world, ree_core.utils.config, regime_occupancy_gate, z_goal_stream). | DV-symmetry (per arm, mandatory declaration, unchanged from 935): DV=fraction_in_external_task, a function of argmax(operating_mode). ARM_NORM and ARM_ABS are BOTH NOT invariant under the DV's symmetry group (constant-offset / monotone-transform of all mode logits) -- the affinity cap clips BEFORE per-mode weighting while external_task_bias is added unclamped afterwards, so clamping moves logit DIFFERENCES; empirically confirmed non-invariant in 934's banked data (seed 42: 0.5606->0.0317->0.0 across caps; seed 43: 1.0->0.4447). | Smoke (--dry-run, 1 seed, run twice due to inherent P2-stage stochasticity at tiny dry-run episode budgets): both structurally clean (no crash, no exception); run 1 (guard-passed) correctly routed PASS/normalised_cap_rule_admits_common_mixed_regime; run 2 (guard contact_rate=0, a different random draw) correctly routed FAIL/substrate_not_ready_requeue/contact_guard_unmet. Both runs show 'ep N/29' progress lines, a 'Seed 47 Condition ...' boundary line, and a 'verdict: PASS/FAIL' line. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings (after fixing a criteria-threshold advisory by adding measured/threshold to both load-bearing criteria, and adding a >=2-distinct-testable-seeds guard on the H-KNIFE qualifying-r computation, matching classify_regime_shape's own DEFAULT_MIN_SEEDS floor, so a run with too few testable seeds cannot spuriously claim a qualifying r). | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 1 finding FIXED, 3 DISMISSED with source citations, 1 rated CLEAR by the reviewer. FIXED (F1): the reachable state C1-passes-but-C2-fails fell through to the H-IDIO else-branch with a route_reason that would have been factually false there ('no r clears the bar' when R_STAR itself had) -- reproducing 935's own defect #2 inside this run's new logic; fixed by adding a distinct rule_grades_but_not_better_than_absolute_cap route (SD-032a direction: weakens), verified by an isolated synthetic test of all 8 (C1,C2,knife) truth-table combinations routing to 4 distinct, correctly-differentiated labels. DISMISSED (F3): affinity_input_cap confirmed read live from self.config at salience_coordinator.py:455 inside tick() -- no arm-order confound beyond ordinary harness-inherited per-cell RNG noise, unchanged from the validated 934/935 harness. DISMISSED (F4): H-KNIFE's single-r bar being looser than the full >=2-adjacent 'graded' classification is a deliberate, already-documented design choice -- it only ever selects between two FAIL sub-routes (rule_right_r_wrong_requeue vs cap_recalibration_is_seed_idiosyncratic), never manufactures a false PASS. DISMISSED (F5): the G-margin/G-calib 0.05 floor concern (possible under-sensitivity vs uninformative-softmax semantics) is inherited unchanged from the validated 934/935 driver, and 934/935's actual measured baseline margins (0.3217-0.8139 across seeds 42-46) sit far above both the floor and any hypothetical uninformative baseline in practice. CLEAR (F2, per reviewer's own rating): manipulation_landed's 1e-6 variation threshold is inherited unchanged from 934/935 and is out of this lettered fix's scope (not one of the autopsy's seven required changes). Causal chain (manipulation/DV/criteria) unchanged by the F1 fix -- only routing/labeling logic changed -- so no re-spawn, per the one-pass rule. predecessor: V3-EXQ-935 (successor; NOT a supersede -- 935's diagnosis of its own four defects stands).

items.title: EXT-002 lineage stage 2a: revisit-rate DV calibration (residue-frozen ablation, no pre-registered verdict)
items.note: EXT-002 lineage stage 2a (CALIBRATION, NOT stage 2 as ratified) -- V3-EXQ-983/983a/1014 lineage. Confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1014_2026-09-09 (Step 8 gate 2026-09-09T00:55:13Z) ratified stage 2's design (residue-frozen ablation, hold-aware per-unit-exposure revisit-avoidance DV, MIN_POOLED_SEEDS=3, seeds drawn until floor met). A subsequent read-only feasibility pass (ext002_stage2_dv_threshold_feasibility_20260911.md, REE_assembly origin/master dc63fe68eb) found NO numeric threshold for that DV derivable from banked data and recommended a calibration-only pass (option a) before committing to the full evidence run. This entry implements that recommendation, reusing stage 2's own MIN_POOLED_SEEDS=3 draw target (not a separate 6-8-seed population -- see script docstring for the compute-cost reasoning) with NO pre-registered pass/fail criterion on the DV itself; it only pools freshly-drawn seeds via the inherited training-completion gate, computes and banks the per-unit-exposure revisit-rate DV's real range, and records the feasibility doc's point-(b) aggregation comparison (min vs median across pooled cells). Claim-free (claim_ids: []); bears_on carried verbatim from 1014 (actor_adequacy_monostrategy [not a registry qid, per 1014 autopsy sec 2], residue_error_persistence_readout). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (per-unit-exposure revisit-avoidance rate) checked against 983a and 1014's banked manifests via the feasibility doc's own inventory -- absent from both (983a's decline field is the barred conditional-repeat-outcome statistic, not this rate; 1014 never computes revisits at all) -> not recoverable, run. | Substrate reuse: imports x983a.run_cell/_make_env/_make_agent/completion_gate/_action_stream_divergence/_positive_control_e1_prediction_error verbatim (already red-teamed substrate, same pattern as V3-EXQ-1023's sibling-module imports); only the seed-draw loop and DV aggregation are new. | red-team (opus): CONTESTED -> 6 fixed (F1 revisit-degenerate seeds diluting the banked range -> excluded from the aggregate, kept in per_seed_dv; F2 degeneracy test used erred-key count instead of revisit count -> switched to revisit-count basis; F3 integer/half-integer threshold disagreement + FAIL-branch could carry passed:true -> half-integer threshold + passed requires non-degeneracy too; F4 A0 mislabelled 'control_arm' in a readout key -> renamed treatment_arm_A0_...; F6 inline completion-gate reimplementation dropped 983a's exclusion_asymmetry report -> now calls x983a.completion_gate directly), 1 disclosed not gated (F5 -- this pool omits 983a's own evidence-run P4 revisit-denominator floor by design, since gating on it would reintroduce a second ungrounded threshold; disclosed via per-seed clears_legacy_p4_floor + interpretation text), 1 dismissed (F7 -- arm_fingerprint cannot distinguish A0/A1 by config_slice alone; confirmed pre-existing/inherited from 983a's own identical design on its real manifest, out of scope for this driver). Full dispositions in the module docstring. | Smoke: dry-run PASS end-to-end post-fix (2 draws, 1 pooled seed non-degenerate, thin-range caution correctly fired in interpretation.text); validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings (arm_fingerprint exemption declared and verified). Compute: reuses the SAME MIN_POOLED_SEEDS=3/~1-in-8-survival draw design already priced by the 1014 autopsy at ~27-38h/12-24 draws; MAX_DRAWS=30 gives headroom above that estimate. Routed to the cloud fleet (machine_affinity=any) per the user's ratified stage-2 terms (not the laptop). Follow-on owed to /governance once this lands: set stage 2's real evidence-run DV threshold from the banked range, and decide the point-(b) aggregation-robustness question (min- vs median-across-pooled-cells) before queuing the full evidence run -- not decided by this entry.

items.title: SD-082 fan-out legs 2+4 (H-learning-signal-sign / H-learning-signal-noisy): 1020 instrument at P1=500 with windowed persistence and episode-level init-head advantage-on-flip
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio for qid sd082_candidate_discriminating_readout_locus, routed by CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1020_2026-09-11 (REE_assembly 92751187b1), ratified gov-20260911-1612, legs user-selected at the autopsy Step 8 gate; hypotheses already pre-registered (not re-registered); chip chip-20260911-sd082-fanout-portfolio-v2. Portfolio = V3-EXQ-1027 (H-replay-rule-state-mismatch, credit-assignment) + V3-EXQ-1028 (H-learning-signal-sign measurement + H-learning-signal-noisy process, one extended-P1 run because both legs' manipulation is the same budget extension) + V3-EXQ-1029 (H-selection-authority-bounded, intrinsic-architecture); run in parallel. New EXQ numbers, NOT a further lettered iteration of 822/1020 (refused by the autopsy). DIAGNOSTIC, directions pinned unknown. | Step 2.5b brake: SD-082 counts 3 (822b/c/d), released by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822f_2026-09-09's own record; diagnostic discriminating WHY -> Not braked. | Step 2.5c: module footprint = V3-EXQ-1020's (call-trace disposition carried forward; SD-082 substrate_paths emptied by governance 2026-09-09); no open corrupting entry executed on this path. | Ethics all-false/allow. | interpretation.criteria_aggregation declared (1020 autopsy sec 5.2 forward-only fix). LEGS 2+4: one arm (centering True), 5 seeds, P1 500 updates. C2 (H-noisy) = windowed persistence W1=[0,70] and W4=[300,end] each vs a bracket measured at that window length (noisy / directed_then_exhausted / persistent_directed). C3 (H-sign) = per-seed Pearson r between episode init-head flip fraction and local (+/-10 ep) advantage, <= -2/sqrt(n) with grand-mean sign agreement, scoreable only with >= 50 init-head flip ticks in each P1 half; 1020's drawn-sample statistic recorded. Readiness: bracket separation >= 0.20 at every window length, >= 95% realised updates, 0 fallbacks, >= 200 ticks. PASS iff readiness AND C1; label carries both legs. | DV-symmetry: windowed persistence invariant only under global rotation/rescale within the window; Pearson r invariant under positive affine maps, not under relabelling flip-heavy episodes -- not invariant. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: 1020 recorded T=70 only, C3 starved (4..61 samples vs 20), no init-head labels -> not recoverable, run. | Smoke: dry-run PASS (5 verdict lines); mid-scale probe seed 633 P1 60: windows + window controls computed, init-head flip ticks 34/30 per half (scales to >> 50 at 250/half), r_local -0.187 computed, 100% updates realised. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 4 FIXED: F1 endpoint C2 aliased exhaustion with noise -> windowed C2; F2 C3 samples extinguish as the head trains (seed 611 froze at 4) -> episode-level init-head statistic; F3 C4 failure could yield a directed label -> c3_degenerate; F4 realised vs intended updates -> readiness + realised window lengths.

items.title: SD-082 fan-out leg 3 (H-selection-authority-bounded): yoked authority x rule-readout ablation (+ magnitude-only pair) -- is the lateral_pfc readout inert at E3 argmin without authority and consequential with it?
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio for qid sd082_candidate_discriminating_readout_locus, routed by CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1020_2026-09-11 (REE_assembly 92751187b1), ratified gov-20260911-1612, legs user-selected at the autopsy Step 8 gate; hypotheses already pre-registered (not re-registered); chip chip-20260911-sd082-fanout-portfolio-v2. Portfolio = V3-EXQ-1027 (H-replay-rule-state-mismatch, credit-assignment) + V3-EXQ-1028 (H-learning-signal-sign measurement + H-learning-signal-noisy process, one extended-P1 run because both legs' manipulation is the same budget extension) + V3-EXQ-1029 (H-selection-authority-bounded, intrinsic-architecture); run in parallel. New EXQ numbers, NOT a further lettered iteration of 822/1020 (refused by the autopsy). DIAGNOSTIC, directions pinned unknown. | Step 2.5b brake: SD-082 counts 3 (822b/c/d), released by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822f_2026-09-09's own record; diagnostic discriminating WHY -> Not braked. | Step 2.5c: module footprint = V3-EXQ-1020's (call-trace disposition carried forward; SD-082 substrate_paths emptied by governance 2026-09-09); no open corrupting entry executed on this path. | Ethics all-false/allow. | interpretation.criteria_aggregation declared (1020 autopsy sec 5.2 forward-only fix). LEG 3: per seed one yoked group of 8 agents on private torch/numpy/random streams (AUTH_OFF intact/ablated, AUTH_ON intact/ablated, MAG x50 intact/ablated, 2 self-yokes), 60 warmup + 60 scored episodes; ablation = compute_bias with rule_state zeroed for that call; untrained (init) head -- scoped. DV = argmin(last_scores) divergence on co-fresh RAW-IDENTICAL ticks (E3 never commits here -- probe committed_fraction 0.0 -- so argmin is the top preference; sampled-action divergence recorded). Readiness per seed: self-yokes 0, head-level rule flip >= 0.01, authority active >= 0.5, >= 50 raw-identical co-fresh ticks, authority_only argmin divergence >= 0.02. PASS iff >= 3 ready seeds AND C1 ON pair >= 0.02 AND C2 OFF pair <= 0.005 (<= 1 divergent tick of ~280) on >= 3; C4 MAG pair suffixes the label (magnitude_alone_suffices / insufficient / test_underpowered vs authority scale factor). | DV-symmetry: argmin is invariant only under a uniform additive shift; the ablation changes the bias non-uniformly through the head ReLU (readiness R2 measures it) in OFF, ON and MAG pairs; authority rescales by spread, which a uniform shift leaves unchanged -- not invariant; self-yokes identity. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: 1020 had no ablation arm and never set authority; 949 measured authority on MECH-314b, not this readout -> not recoverable, run. | Smoke: dry-run PASS (5 verdict lines); mid-scale probe seed 611 (warmup 20, score 15): self-yokes 0/649, OFF pair argmin 0/71, ON pair 19/71, MAG pair 0/71, authority_only 60/71, raw-identical 100% of co-fresh. Runtime estimate from probe: ~60 min/seed. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 6 FIXED, 1 scope: F1 multinomial commits -> argmin DV; F2 authority co-rescales gated_policy + scale-free -> MAG pair + narrowed PASS text; F3 bias ~0.02 in tanh linear region (scope: raw magnitude, not the bound); F4 post-divergence echo -> raw-identical ticks; F5 single-event thresholds -> 60 scored eps, zero-tolerance stated; F6 authority reach -> R5; F7 over-reaching label text removed.

items.title: E3 channel-commensurability rung-3 SELECTION-LEVEL readiness re-pose (commit-flip rate under shadow OFF/ON scoring) -- MECH-439
items.note: SELECTION-LEVEL re-pose of V3-EXQ-1012's acceptance instrument (parked, never queued: experiments/_scratch/v3_exq_1012_..._.py.blocked). V3-EXQ-1012's target ('>=2 E3 score channels above a 1e-3 relative cross-candidate share') was proven an arithmetic identity of the operator (Step 4.5 red-team fable BLOCKING, 2026-09-08; see evidence/planning/exq1012_blocked_readiness_target_tautological_20260908.md). Governance re-posed the target (GFLAG-0234, /governance option A, user-approved 2026-09-10, REE_assembly 5dc661badc, all 4 carrier docs already amended) onto a SELECTION-level DV: commit-flip rate under shadow OFF/ON scoring on the same tick and candidate set. Full build spec: evidence/planning/mech439_rung3_selection_level_repose_20260914.md. DESIGN: 2 arms (C_fed_operator_on, C_starved_operator_on), operator ALWAYS ON in both -- no separate OFF arm; the OFF/ON comparison is done INTRA-TICK by transparently capturing each genuine tick's score_trajectory calls and replaying them with the toggle flipped (class _ScoreCallCapture), plus a same-config self-check that must reproduce the live scores exactly. DV characterises the PRIMARY-score stage only (not a final-commit-level replay through the modulatory shortlist stage -- deliberate build-time scoping decision, design doc section 6a; a final-commit-level successor needs a small e3_selector.py refactor, not built here). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: banked V3-EXQ-571c manifest and the 1012 smoke record only per-cell aggregates (shares, variances), never per-tick per-candidate raw scores a shadow OFF/ON comparison needs -> not recoverable, run. | Step 2.5b brake: MECH-439 carries >=2 counted substrate_ceiling autopsies but this is a diagnostic on the MEASUREMENT axis (does the operator have a selection-consequential effect), same determination the parked 1012 driver made for this substrate -> Not braked. | Substrate: SD-E3-CHANNEL-COMMENSURABILITY rung 3 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3 c47b885, 2026-09-07); live-probed this session (use_e3_channel_commensurability toggle reaches agent.e3.config; EMA state confirmed unmutated by a bare score_trajectory replay). | Ethics: all-false/allow. | Smoke: dry-run PASS both cells, self_check_failures=0, z_goal_stream no writer defect, validate_experiments.py --strict OK. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 4 findings, all fixed before queueing: (1) the non-forced-ness check (regimes_differ) was computed but never routed -- now a both-regimes-pass reading with regimes_differ False routes to a distinct flagged FAIL label instead of the clean both-regimes PASS; (2) the SD-scaled PASS bar conflated 'no effect' with 'heterogeneous effect' across the 4 seeds -- added a majority-of-seeds-clear-the-absolute-floor test (PASS iff EITHER test clears), and split the flip_rate_lift criterion's measured/threshold per regime instead of a cross-arm max/min pair; (3) the shadow-replay capture snapshotted _chan_scale_ema but not _chan_scale_n, which ALSO gates the commensurability-scale warmup no-op -- fixed to snapshot/restore both together (not schedule-reachable at full scale since the warmup crossing lands in unscored P0, but now correct rather than schedule-lucky); (4) added a shadow_scores_measurably_different precondition closing a residual gap where the tick-count-based operator_engaged gate could in principle read green while shadow and live scores stayed bit-identical, and loosened SELF_CHECK_TOLERANCE from an effectively bit-identity absolute check to a relative+floor one. Re-smoked clean after every fix. | MECH-439's direction does not move on this record.
